cog.donate_body:
**Amount:** `{amount}`

Your donation helps cover hosting costs and keeps Niko running! As a thank-you you'll receive the {badge} **Supporter** badge and role in the support server.

Choose a cryptocurrency on the checkout page, send the exact amount shown, and your badge arrives as soon as it confirms.
cog.limits_note: -# Any amount from {min} to {max} works too: `/donate amount:`
cog.dm_body:
Your donation of **{amount}** in **{currency}** has been confirmed. You've been granted the {badge} **Supporter** badge!

-# Track ID: `{track}`
cog.public_body: <@{user}> just donated **{amount}** in **{currency}**! Thank you for supporting Niko! {badge}
cog.invalid_track: That track ID belongs to another donation.
